basis: Qualitative continuation review of existing project reports and implemented candidate families, not a new numerical experiment or global architecture search.

scope.policy: current CNN-only full seven-dimensional controller and listed existing variants
scope.downstream_goal: source-feedback SPT improvement of future SPI learning at comparable finite budgets

admission_requirements: A specific falsifiable full-control hypothesis with an evidence-to-intervention connection; prior proof of winning is not required.
A substantive new basis relative to stopped configurations; rename, neighboring coefficients, restarts, seeds or budget expansion alone are insufficient.
Comparable complete action interface, fixed budget/loss/stabilization, permitted observations and explicit capacity/external-data/compute accounting.
One paired scope, main success/nonregression measures, prespecified worthwhile improvement, budgets and outcome-dependent stopping/continuation actions before a new run.

candidates.name: repeat_current_configuration
candidates.rationale: Original G did not meet its frozen transfer and source-guard conditions; restoration or repetition is not a new intervention.
candidates.limitation: This is not a claim that low absolute success prevents all meta-learning gains.

candidates.name: phase_or_gripper_weighting
candidates.rationale: The tested local weighting branch failed its original rules; the current task preserves the existing loss.
candidates.limitation: Does not reject every possible loss; the unrelated phase/gripper report worktree edit is preserved.

candidates.name: public_state_jitter_500
candidates.rationale: The documented 500-update closed-loop comparison did not support an aggregate repair.
candidates.limitation: The old baseline was a pinned prior reference, not a fresh arm in that run; do not pool it with other experiments.

candidates.name: original_cnn_gru_variant
candidates.rationale: The capacity-matched original GRU contrast did not establish an overall fit advantage to motivate reopening that configuration.
candidates.limitation: Two tasks, one seed, phase-balanced offline setting; no universal or closed-loop GRU rejection.

candidates.name: tested_motion_history_route
candidates.rationale: Offline improvement did not carry through to the documented paired routed-controller episodes.
candidates.limitation: The current_all7 baseline is a newly fitted readout, not the original B action head; does not reject all history architectures.

candidates.name: repeat_current_input_same_history_head
candidates.rationale: All documented additional successes came from one seed; this does not justify treating the alias input as a stable full-controller repair.
candidates.limitation: Both arms use the same candidate head, so the original B Policy is not the comparator.

candidates.name: remove_stabilization
candidates.rationale: The same-stack fresh zero/five comparison did not establish common task/seed improvement; five is fixed in the current task.
candidates.limitation: No claim that all reset interventions are ineffective.

candidates.name: task7_single_component_auxiliary_search
candidates.rationale: The retained signals are fit-only and affect one action component; no operational full seven-dimensional control intervention is defined.
candidates.limitation: SLSQP remains scientifically frozen and unexecuted; not_found is not global infeasibility.

candidates.name: extend_policy_updates
candidates.rationale: The current question fixes 500 updates; old longer-budget offline curves are not fixed-500 closed-loop evidence.
candidates.limitation: Does not claim training converged at 500 or that larger budgets can never help.

unassessed_new_backend_alternatives.note: External pretrained encoders, other action models or new collection schemes have no single operational design in this review; a substantively new proposal can reopen the decision.

existing_evidence.reconstruction: 15 A-origin byte counterparts reported previously; not reopened or rehashed here

counterfactual: Restoring all old artifacts does not by itself supply a new intervention or reverse this review.
next_main_task: Independent Continual World feasibility and task-stream protocol design; no CW training has been started.
